title: Hazard Hunt
audience: New warehouse associates, team leads, L&D teams
summary: Spot hazards in a realistic 3D warehouse, replay a near-miss with pause-and-decide moments, rank controls with the hierarchy of controls, and practice reporting to a busy supervisor. Fictional company. Does not replace training required by law or by your employer.
contentNotes: Includes a replay of a fictional warehouse near-miss. Nobody is hurt and no injuries are shown.

poster.alt: A receiving dock in a night-shift warehouse: a dark spill sheen on the concrete floor in the foreground, blue pallet racking loaded with stock on both sides, an orange pallet jack, red steel drums and a dock door with its red-green traffic signal beyond
